name: order_complete_metabolic_panel
description: Orders a Complete Metabolic Panel (CMP) including glucose, calcium, sodium, potassium, CO2, chloride, BUN, creatinine, albumin, total protein, ALP, ALT, AST, and bilirubin. Used for comprehensive metabolic screening and monitoring organ function.

clinical_indication.description: Clinical reason for ordering the CMP

when_to_use: Monitoring known kidney or liver disease
Medication monitoring affecting renal or hepatic function
